stage1.impression: It reads as a believable layout for a long, narrow bar at night: warm pendants, the bar top pooled with light, a row of stools, and booths falling into shadow. At 1:1 it is clearly a render. The floor is covered in large, hard-edged, puddle-shaped blotches. The haze turns the back-bar into a flat grey fog, so the acrylic shelves read as plain glowing lines rather than thick polished acrylic. The frosted screen is a flat white rectangle. The hero, the red Ember speaker, is a pink sliver hidden behind the last stools, and the far end belongs to two black lounge chairs.

blocking_9: The Ember speaker must read as the hero at a glance: an unoccluded silhouette with its red tint and the light through its acrylic visible, not a pink sliver behind the stools
The floor must read as polished concrete with no large hard-edged blotches or puddle shapes
The back-bar must show its bottles, the steel and the thick shelf edges, not a grey veil of haze
The frosted screens must glow at the same warm, low key as the room, not as a flat bright white panel
The booths must hold shadow detail (crush below 10 % in the right-hand third)
Some sign of life near the camera (a glass, a menu or a coat in the foreground), and no props that read as glowing blue phones
Full resolution with no denoiser smear on the record wall and listening room

defects.what: Large irregular dark blotches with hard edges, like puddles or a contrasty stain map, across the concrete floor. They read as CG and not as shadows
The back-bar is washed to an even grey by haze. The acrylic shelves read as thin white light lines, the bottles are barely visible and the steel is lost
The Ember speaker is almost entirely hidden behind bar stools and a chair. Only a pink-red sliver shows, and its red is desaturated toward pink (dE2000 17 against #C0392B)
Two black lounge chairs fill the listening-room opening and become the visual end point instead of the speaker
The frosted screen is a flat, near-white rectangle (median 92, slightly cool with b > g) with no falloff or depth. It reads as a lit poster or monitor
The booths and the right wall are crushed (20 % crush, median 12). The leather and the fir caps are barely legible
Small objects on the bar top glow cyan and blue (they read as phones or screens), the only cool colour in the room besides the screen
The record wall and listening room are smeared by the denoiser and have no record detail
The ceiling and beams are a flat brown with no fir grain, checks or end grain visible

changes.problem: The hero speaker is hidden behind the stools and chairs, so the frame has no hero.

evidence.measured: speaker region is 35 x 50 px, mostly occluded by stool backs; lum_median 67, red only at the edges

change.to: position [1.6, 1.9, 1.35], target [17.0, 2.6, 1.0], 35 mm, focus on the Ember speaker

changes.expected: The Ember sits in clear view down the aisle between the stools and the booths, about 1.5 times larger, with its whole silhouette visible and framed by the partition opening

changes.problem: The concrete floor carries large, hard-edged, puddle-shaped blotches that read as a bad texture.

evidence.measured: profile y bins 52.8/49.9/37.5/47.1/43.7/47.4/52.4/60.0: irregular dips with crisp boundaries rather than a smooth falloff

change.setting: floor material: stain map contrast and polish
change.to: stain contrast reduced about 70 % and broken up at a smaller scale (0.2 to 0.5 m features, soft edges), roughness 0.35, so the pendants leave soft glossy streaks

changes.expected: An even warm-grey polished concrete with soft reflections of the pendants and stools, and no puddle shapes

changes.problem: Haze greys the whole back-bar, so the acrylic, bottles and steel lose contrast.

evidence.measured: lum_median 76, p5 23; it reads as an even grey veil with the bottles barely visible

changes.expected: The back-bar steel goes near black, the bottles and shelf edges stand out, and the pendant cones are only faintly visible

changes.problem: The frosted screen is a flat, slightly cool white panel that outshines the room and competes with the speaker.

evidence.measured: lum_median 92, r 103 / g 89 / b 93 (cooler than the 2400 K room)

change.to: 0.5, tinted toward 3000 K, with the frosted acrylic's roughness raised so the image softens at its edges

changes.expected: A soft, warm glowing panel, darker than the pendants and the bar top, with the hands still legible

changes.problem: The Ember speaker's red is weak and pinkish, so the room's one colour does not land.

change.setting: on each Ember speaker, area lamps
change.to: 4 x 45 W/m2 at 2700 K, plus the listening room's other lights lowered so the speaker is the brightest thing at the far end

changes.expected: The speaker's acrylic glows a saturated ember red with visible batts, and it is the frame's only saturated colour

changes.problem: The booths and right wall fall to crushed black, so the leather and fir are not readable.

change.to: table lamp 600 W, sconce 140 W, so each booth gets its own pool of light

changes.expected: Each booth shows a warm pool on its table, the tan leather is legible, and dark gaps remain between the booths

changes.problem: Blue and cyan glowing objects on the bar read as phones, and no foreground prop says anyone is here.

evidence.measured: seen: small cyan rectangles along the bar top; no foreground props

change.from: small glowing blue items on the bar; empty foreground
change.to: replace them with rocks glasses and amber votives; add a half-full coupe and a folded menu on the nearest bar-top corner, and a coat over one stool

changes.expected: Warm small highlights along the bar and a sign of life near the lens, with no cool hues except the screen

changes.problem: The ceiling's fir beams are a flat brown with no grain, and the far end is denoiser-smeared.

evidence.measured: lum_range 38, p5 17 to p95 55: a flat, untextured band

change.setting: the fir's stain and render samples
change.to: fir with visible grain, checks and darker end grain, plus a grazing pendant spill onto the beams; 512 samples, adaptive 0.01 at full 2400 x 1600

changes.expected: The beams read as old Douglas fir with soft highlights on their faces, and the records at the far end hold sleeve detail

out_of_scope.request: Move or remove the two black lounge chairs in the listening room that block the speaker
out_of_scope.why: The listening room's furniture and layout are fixed by the card. The camera move (c1) works around them instead

out_of_scope.request: A more saturated red for the Ember cabinet itself
out_of_scope.why: The speaker's colour is fixed. Only the light on and through it may change
